Special Council Meeting - 3 March 2026

Tuesday, March 3, 2026 - 06:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, Lundy Ave, Cunderdin

PUBLIC NOTICE OF SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING

 

Pursuant to Section 5.25(g) of the Local Government Act 1995 and Admin. Reg.12.

Notice is hereby given that a Special Meeting of Council will be held on Tuesday 3rd March 2026, commencing at 6pm in the Shire of Cunderdin Council Chambers.

 

The purpose of the meeting is to consider:

Confidential – Negotiations Evaluation – RFT 05-25/26 Design & Construct Aquatic Infrastructure and Accessibility Works & RFT 06-25/26 Design & Construct Wellness Hub & Visitor Facilities.

 

Stuart Hobley

Chief Executive Officer

Special Council Meeting - 24 August 2021

Tuesday, August 24, 2021 - 05:00 PM

PUBLIC NOTICE

Notice of a Special Council Meeting – 24th August 2021

For the purpose of considering an offer received for the purchase of Lot 231 Dowerin Meckering Road, Meckering.

 

The Meeting will be held;

Date: Tuesday, 24th August 2021

Place: Shire of Cunderdin Council Chambers, Cunderdin, WA, 6407

Time: 5:00 pm

Any interested persons are welcome to attend.

LEMC (Local Emergency Management Committee)

Local Emergency Management Committee (LEMC) meetings are to be held three (3) times per year generally in the Shire of Cunderdin Council Chambers.  For information on the currently scheduled meeting dates, please contact the Shire Administration Office.

LEMC Minutes

BFAC (Bush Fire Advisory Committee)

The Bush Fire Advisory Committee (BFAC) is established pursuant to Section 67 of the Bush Fires Act 1954. Its role is to advise the Council on bushfire matters pertaining to bush fire prevention, preparedness, and response within the Shire of Cunderdin.

BFAC Minutes

Annual Electors Meeting 

A general meeting of the electors of the Shire of Cunderdin is to be held once every financial year.

The Electors meeting is held on a day selected by the local government.  The date chosen will be no more than 56 days after the Council has accepted the annual report for the previous financial
year. 

Annual Electors Meeting Minutes
